test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the blanks, will complete the letter series.

P _ G I O _ D _ I O R D G _ O _ D G I O
solution:
Given:

P _ G I O _ D _ I O R D G _ O _ D G I O

Checking all the given options:

**1.** G Q D S I

P G G I O / Q D D I O / R D G S O / I D G I O

**2. D Q G I S**

**P** D G I O / **Q** D G I O / **R** D G I O / **S** D G I O

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb8617946650f3e47268cd3ad155af8a5a3e28c1bc0f0585d7f61852b85ccc32.png] 

Here, the series is completed.

**3.** Q G D I S

P Q G I O / G D D I O / R D G I O / S D G I O

**4.** S I D G Q

P S G I O / I D D I O / R D G G O / Q D G I O

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
